review_scope: Adversarial review of target/outcome separation, finite Attention measurement, exact causal organization, partial versus absolute scope, target Denotation, Care history, Respect constraints, canonical dependency projections, countermodels, and formal boundaries.

findings.resolution: Intention no longer equates its target with the guided result; the exact upstream target Difference guides an activity whose output may differ.
Absolute Attention no longer relies on an unconstrained list of available Differences; it is exact equality of organized and available channels under one Attention.
Respect now proves that its named Constraint admits the actor scoped Action as well as carrying a typed protection witness for the other Entity.
Care requires the attended target State to belong to the cared-for Entity Persistence history and joins the exact Entity-State Denotation to an organized action channel.
Every canonical dependency receives a formalized, represented-by, prose-only, or outside-boundary disposition; local channel projections cannot disappear from the ledger.
Attention uses exact organized and available list lengths with a nonempty denominator, subset proof, shared upstream Difference, and downstream result for every counted channel.
The partial-Attention countermodel negates an AbsoluteAttention wrapper around the same Attention instead of proving only an unrelated omitted item.

Normative and interpersonal reverse anti-entailments remain binding prose explicitly outside the reduct because closed-world benefit, consent, morality, agreement, and affection predicates are absent.
The promotion leaves Consciousness and the proposed Authority revision unchanged and limits v0.20 to the eight dependency-closed terms.
